# MealCoreAI
> AI-powered personalised Indian meal planning for PCOS, Diabetes, Thyroid, Pregnancy, Kids, Cholesterol, and Weight Loss.

## About
MealCoreAI generates daily personalised Indian meal plans adapted to the user's specific health condition, routine, and regional food preferences. Plans are ready in 90 seconds. Free to start. Built for Indian users who need condition-specific, nutritionist-reviewed meal guidance.
